metadata.description: Daniel (Elian-Studio)'s Claude Code plugin marketplace. Ships elian-store (bundled workflow skills, agents, hooks, and skill-owned validators) and elian-workflow (issue-cycle work-history recording to Notion).

plugins.name: elian-store
plugins.description: Workflow bundle with requirements intake, gated design-document generation and change propagation, decision artifacts, TDD implementation flows, engineering and persona review, PR review and drafting, verification orchestration, requirement coverage, harness sync, and bundled domain agents.

plugins.name: elian-workflow
plugins.description: The development lifecycle as one plugin: 19 stage-ordered skills from idea through spec, issue kickoff, architecture, TDD implementation, review, verification, PR drafting, and recorded issue history, plus the 30 agents those stages dispatch. Overlaps elian-store by 17 skills — install one, not both. Only the two issue-cycle skills need a Notion workspace config.
